_readme: Driver photos. Empty on purpose: every card falls back to the team-colour number design. Add an entry per driver code only once you have the right to show the picture: { "file": "VER.webp", "credit": "Photographer / agency", "licence": "e.g. licensed, or CC BY 4.0", "source": "https://…", "face": [0.5, 0.4], "width": 1000, "height": 1500 }. Put the file next to this one. Nothing is shown, and nothing is requested, for a driver without an entry.
